description: Election Commission - L. Kokilan was selected as the member of the Valikamam South P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam South Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by a recognized political party, which falls under Election-related matters.
